Error codes: 09 §3 equals openapi.yaml; every '`NNN CODE`' mention matches
Authenticated mutations require X-CSRF-Token; POST commands require Idempotency-Key (09 §2, §4)
Every invariant, transition and T01 scenario has a test in 11
06 eligibility, uncertainty and classification codes equal openapi.yaml

npm run test:backend (consumer contract suite, unchanged frontend)
